integrity: The dimension bounds and matrix-unit construction are given by explicit proofs; the standalone Python checker verifies finite instances and does not establish universality or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The matching closed form requires at most two arrows per ordered vertex pair; the all-multiplicity exact formula is a finite integer optimization. The theorem concerns minimal dimension of a faithful unital representation, not all module isomorphism classes. Historical priority risk remains from implicit earlier faithful-embedding classifications. The results have no independent mathematical audit.
title: Matching-controlled minimum faithful degree of radical-square-zero quiver algebras
